name: Bauernhof Dallnhof
beschreibung: The Bauernhof Dallnhof is situated in Bad Häring in the Tyrolean Unterland, operating as a charming farmhouse inn with guest rooms. Combining active farming with warm hospitality, it welcomes holidaymakers looking for both comfortable lodging and hearty country cuisine. Its convenient position in the Inn Valley provides effortless access to nearby hiking trails and premier ski resorts. Delicious homemade farm products freshly complement the dining menu. The functionally furnished rooms offer lovely views across the surrounding mountain panorama, serving as an ideal base for hiking, cycling, and winter sports.
